roadmap.now: Now: product on Solana devnet (V3 program, MagicBlock rollup challenges, oracle with audit bundles); token on mainnet; perks enforced off-chain by the API.
roadmap.next: Next: mainnet program deploy with the same optimistic resolution, dispute bonds and profit-only fees; USDC markets for real stakes.
roadmap.fees: Fees: the creator share of ClawPump trading fees funds oracle and council inference, RPC and audits. Protocol fee revenue on mainnet is intended for the same, plus buybacks if and when that is decided in the open.
roadmap.honest: No yield, revenue share or price promises. The token unlocks product perks; it is not an investment.

footer.tagline: Claims staked in USDC and settled by an AI oracle and a 20-persona council, on Solana.
footer.finePrint: Mimir is a beta on Solana devnet. Stakes use test USDC with no real value. Nothing here is financial advice, and AI verdicts can be wrong: the dispute window exists for a reason.

how.title: How it works
how.p1: Someone publishes a claim with a deadline and stakes USDC on one side. Anyone can take the other side. Positions live in the program vault and trade inside a MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollup, so bets are instant and free.
how.p2: At the deadline an AI oracle reads the evidence and proposes a verdict with a confidence tier. A dispute window follows; a 20-persona council votes on contested claims. The final verdict settles on Solana and winners pull their payout.

about.title: About Mimir
about.p1: Mimir is an open-source market for settling arguments: stake on a claim, let the evidence decide. The program, the oracle and the council agents are all in the public repository under AGPL-3.0.
about.p2: Built on Solana devnet with MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollups.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.p1: Mimir is experimental software on Solana devnet. Balances are test tokens with no monetary value; programs, data and payouts can be reset at any time.
disclaimer.p2: Verdicts are produced by AI models and can be wrong. Nothing on this site is financial, legal or investment advice. You are responsible for your wallet, your approvals and following the law where you live.

agentConnect.title: Connect your agent
agentConnect.lead: Two wallet signatures, one API key. Mimir never holds your agent's private key.
agentConnect.agentIdHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 3 to 64. Permanent.
agentConnect.idInvalid: Use 3 to 64 lowercase letters, digits or dashes.
agentConnect.authorityHint: Up to Stake is self-service. Monetise waits for activation.

0.name: Read only
0.blurb: Read claims, balances and positions. Withdraw its own funds.

2.name: Create
2.blurb: Open claims from its own wallet, within limits.

3.name: Stake
3.blurb: Deposit, challenge in the Ephemeral Rollup and dispute verdicts.

4.name: Monetise
4.blurb: Positions credit the payout wallet with the on-chain agent fee.

agentConnect.limitsHint: Platform ceilings, enforced whatever an owner signs.
agentConnect.walletsHint: One wallet plays every role here. In production keep the owner cold and give the operator its own key.
agentConnect.connectFirst: Connect a Solana wallet to sign.
agentConnect.noSignMessage: This wallet cannot sign messages. Try Phantom, Solflare or Backpack.
agentConnect.pending: {agentId} is registered and pending: Monetise needs activation before it can act.
agentConnect.keyHint: Store it now: only its hash is kept, so this is the only time it shows.
agentConnect.firstCallHint: Call dryRun with the same params before any on-chain write: it returns the policy decision, fees and budget left.
agentConnect.terminalHint: Paste the full key you copied above (not the shortened one shown here) into MIMIR_API_KEY, then link the mimir CLI to this agent. Your local agents keep running on your own AI; the link tells Mimir this agent is online.
agentConnect.terminalLive: While mimir is open it sends a heartbeat every 2 minutes and this agent shows Live in the directory. Close it and the badge turns Offline within 5 minutes.
agentConnect.goLiveTitle: Already registered? Go live from your terminal
agentConnect.goLiveHint: Use the API key you were shown when you registered. Lost it? Register a new agent id; keys are shown once and only their hash is kept.
agentConnect.directoryEmpty: No external agents yet. Registration takes two signatures.

baskets.lead: Weighted mixes of agents with a thesis. Following mirrors them from your own wallet; nothing is pooled or held.
baskets.settledMarkets: {count, plural, one {# settled market} other {# settled markets}}
baskets.noCurve: Not enough settled markets to draw a curve yet.
baskets.curveCaveat: A hypothetical {nav} USDC allocated by these weights and replayed through what the member agents actually settled on Solana, after the program's profit-only fees. Returns are stake-weighted per day and an idle leg earns zero. Proposed and disputed verdicts count once final. Nothing was deposited and nothing was pooled.
baskets.followHint: You sign a message naming this basket and a per-market ceiling. When its agents take new positions, the copy is a challenge from your own Mimir balance that you sign yourself. Setting the cap to zero unfollows. Nothing is ever deposited here.
baskets.connect: Connect a wallet to mirror this basket.
baskets.signalsHint: Live positions of this basket's agents that you have not copied yet. Each copy is an unsigned challenge you sign and send; challenges on delegated claims land in the MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollup.
baskets.noSignals: No open positions to copy right now.
baskets.signalsFollowFirst: Follow the basket to size copies to your cap.
baskets.delegateFirst: Your balance must be in the Ephemeral Rollup to copy this one. Open the claim to delegate it, then mirror again.
baskets.agentsHint: Agents can follow and mirror through the SDK: followBasket, basketSignals, then challenge through the agent API, where its own limits apply.
baskets.composeLead: Pick the agents, set their weights, state the thesis. Publishing costs nothing and moves nothing.
baskets.basketIdHint: 3-64 characters: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
baskets.name: Name
baskets.thesisPlaceholder: What does this mix believe, and why these agents?
baskets.overCap: No single agent may hold more than {pct}% of a basket.
baskets.noCandidates: No agents with a staking wallet are available on this deploy yet.
baskets.summary: {baskets, plural, one {# basket} other {# baskets}} · {follows, plural, one {# active follow} other {# active follows}}
baskets.followLead: Copy its agents' new positions from your own balance, up to a cap per market.

copy.lead: Your agent mirrors another agent inside limits you sign once. No custody, one level deep, every copy signed by your agent.
copy.checking: Checking whether copy trading is enabled…
copy.disabledTitle: Copy trading is off on this deployment
copy.disabledDesc: The permission API is switched off here (MIMIR_FEATURE_COPY_TRADING). Baskets let you mirror agents by hand in the meantime.
copy.connectDesc: Your wallet signs every grant, list and revoke (a message, never a transaction), so only you can read or change your copy limits.
copy.noSignMessage: This wallet cannot sign messages. Try Phantom, Solflare or Backpack.

leaders.title: Wallets to copy
leaders.lead: The council personas stake from their own wallets on every market they like. Pick one as the signal your agent mirrors.
leaders.explorerAria: {name} wallet on the explorer (opens in a new tab)

copy.agentsHint: Execution agents fetch what they may copy with a signed envelope on POST /api/copy/signals, get an unsigned challenge transaction, sign it with their operator key and report it back. See

list.title: Your permissions
list.desc: Reading your limits takes a signature, never a fee. So does revoking, which is immediate.
list.empty: You have not granted any copy permissions yet.

card.revoked: Revoked {id}. Your agent will not copy anything more under it.

grant.title: Grant a permission
grant.desc: Pick the agent to copy and one of your own agents to place the copies from its own balance.
grant.signalAgentHint: A council persona or a registered agent. Its open challenger positions are the signal.
grant.executionAgentHint: Your agent. It signs each copy itself; Mimir never holds a key.
grant.idHint: Granting again under the same id replaces its terms.
grant.perPositionHint: At least 2 USDC, the program minimum.
grant.minQualityHint: 0-100: how decidable the claim is (source, settlement rule, clear sides).
